_doc: THE INTENT CONTRACT — the 'initial picture / goals / design' declared UP FRONT, per build/asset/flow, BEFORE any execution. It is authored at REQUESTED time (spec_author.author_intent_contract), hashed, and ledgered so it CANNOT be retro-fitted to match the result. It is the SINGLE rubric the capture is compared against at EVERY stage (plan -> execute -> qa -> capture -> compare). It versions + diffs like DESIGN.md so target drift is itself caught (v_intent_contract_no_drift). Doctrine preserved: fail-closed (no contract OR no acceptance band => BLOCKED, never silent PASS); thresholds ratchet UP only — confidence_target lives in the graduated-autonomy band [0.95, 0.99], starting at the operator-chosen 0.95 floor and ratcheting toward the 0.99 calibrated ceiling, enforced as max(author, frozen ASSET_TYPE_FLOORS.confidence_floor); review-only (reaching the contract gates PROMOTED_TO_REVIEW, never auto-accept).

fields.intent_id: string  — stable id, '<asset_id>__intent' ; one contract per build/flow
fields.asset_type: string  — matches AssetTask.asset_type; selects the promotion profile (engine.load_promotion_profile) AND the default validator/optics rubric set
fields.flow_kind: asset|build|flow  — asset=single mesh/material; build=composed scene/level; flow=multi-step gameplay sequence. Selects which capture stages exist.
fields.schema_version: string  — 'dimwit/intent_contract/v1' ; bumped only by an operator-reviewed schema change
fields.authored_ts: int (unix)  — set ONCE at authoring; immutable; used to prove the contract pre-dates the evidence
fields.authored_by: string  — 'spec_author'|'operator'|'<llm-model>' ; provenance of the target itself

goals._doc: Human-readable intent + machine-checkable per-dimension targets. The per-dimension targets are the rubric numbers compare_to_target() scores the capture against.
goals.summary: string  — one-sentence statement of what this build must be
goals.intended_gameplay_role: string  — carried from AssetTask.intended_gameplay_role (core.py:84); e.g. 'mid-lane hostile the player reads at 25m'
goals.target_dimensions: object<dim:float 0..1>  — per-SCORED_DIMENSIONS targets (core.py:40 SCORED_DIMENSIONS). e.g. {"third_person_camera_readability":0.95,"hit_destroy_state_clarity":0.9}. Dims omitted inherit the asset_type promotion-profile default. These REPLACE the literal 0.6 placeholders in spec_author.py:41.
goals.load_bearing_dimensions: array<string>  — the dims that MUST individually clear acceptance.dimension_floors (cannot be averaged away). e.g. ['third_person_camera_readability','gameplay_readability','not_black_blob']

design_law._doc: The applicable slice of the GLOBAL visual law (WanefallGreybox/DESIGN.md) + LOCAL overrides. This binds the per-build contract to the canonical law the design_md validator domain already lints (dimwit/pipelines/design_md.py).
design_law.design_md_path: string  — abs path to the canonical DESIGN.md (default 'C:/Users/developer/Documents/Unreal Projects/WanefallGreybox/DESIGN.md')
design_law.design_md_hash: string  — sha256 of DESIGN.md at authoring; if it differs at compare-time the global law drifted under the build -> BLOCKED
design_law.token_slice: array<string>  — the DESIGN.md token/section ids this build is governed by (e.g. ['materials.carapace-metallic','materials.weakpoint-emissive','cameras.tp-grading'])
design_law.canon_expectations: object  — concrete DESIGN.md canon values asserted for THIS build, e.g. {"carapace_metallic":0.0,"weakpoint_emissive":1.0,"near_black_not_pure_black":true,"tp_white_temp_k":7000}
design_law.local_overrides: object<token:value>  — per-build deviations from the global law, each REQUIRING a justification string; an override with no justification => BLOCKED

expected_appearance._doc: What the build should LOOK like, in words + optional reference imagery. perception.compare_to_target() and optics.target_confidence() consume reference_images as the declared picture.
expected_appearance.description: string  — strict prose description a senior artist would write ('dark alien carapace, teal Wane spinal vein, single orange weak-point at the chest, clean readable silhouette at lane distance')
expected_appearance.reference_images: array<string>  — abs paths to the declared initial picture(s) / target render(s). MAY be empty for a text-only target, in which case acceptance.allow_textonly_target MUST be true or the build is BLOCKED.
expected_appearance.must_have_traits: array<string>  — REQUIRED_IDENTITY-style traits this build must exhibit (core.py:136); checked against the rendered evidence, not just the spec
expected_appearance.forbidden_traits: array<string>  — FORBIDDEN_IDENTITY-style traits (core.py:124); a measured occurrence is a hard fail
expected_appearance.silhouette_note: string  — what the silhouette must communicate (drives silhouette_readability target + optics clean_silhouette)

acceptance._doc: HARD acceptance criteria. confidence_target is the fused 0.99 gate-to-REVIEW (ratchet-up only, floored at 0.99). dimension_floors stop a weak load-bearing dim being averaged away (closes the engine.py:255-262 inflatable-mean gap). target_match_floor forces non-trivial similarity to the declared picture.
acceptance.confidence_target: float  — fused-confidence required to reach PROMOTED_TO_REVIEW. In the ratchet band [0.95, 0.99]; RATCHET UP ONLY (max(declared, frozen ASSET_TYPE_FLOORS.confidence_floor)); starts at the operator-chosen 0.95 floor, calibrated destination 0.99. NEVER auto-accept.
acceptance.dimension_floors: object<dim:float>  — per-load-bearing-dim minimums; min(load_bearing dims) must clear these BEFORE the mean is even considered
acceptance.target_match_floor: float  — minimum capture-vs-declared-picture similarity (perception.compare_to_target + optics matches_reference); default 0.85; a build that scores a high style-mean but doesn't resemble its declared picture cannot promote
acceptance.allow_textonly_target: bool  — if true a contract may declare no reference image (text-only target); if false (default for asset_type in characters/enemies) a missing reference => BLOCKED
acceptance.max_target_drift: float  — allowed intent_hash-stable cosine/field drift between the authored contract and any later contract version before v_intent_contract_no_drift FAILS (target-drift caught like DESIGN.md baseline regression)
acceptance.require_perception: bool  — default true; if true and numpy/Pillow OR evidence images are absent the build is BLOCKED (closes the engine.py:21-25 fail-OPEN gap so 0.99 can never be hit on declared-only data)
acceptance.require_optics_semantic: bool  — default true for character/enemy; if true and the vision-LLM is unavailable the build is BLOCKED, never PASS (mirrors optics.py fail-closed)

validation_plan._doc: Which validators + optics rubrics apply to THIS build. The director/suite loads these so the contract is the single source of which gates run, not a hardcoded set.
validation_plan.validator_domains: array<string>  — validation_registry domains that MUST be green for this build (e.g. ['hi3d_characters','rigged_skeletal_meshes','design_md','intent_conformance'])
validation_plan.optics_rubric: string  — which optics judge applies: 'character'|'image'|'motion' (selects judge_character/judge_image/judge_motion in optics.py)
validation_plan.required_capture_stages: array<string>  — the stages that MUST produce a real capture compared to the target: subset of ['plan','execute','hero','player_camera','motion']; an empty list => BLOCKED
validation_plan.golden_corpus_refs: array<string>  — fixture ids this build's contract must not regress (ties into v_golden_regression_corpus)

provenance._doc: Provenance of the BUILD source AND of the target imagery, both fail-closed (mirrors core.evaluate_provenance). A declared reference image with no license is unusable as a target.
provenance.reference_license: string  — license covering expected_appearance.reference_images; required if reference_images is non-empty

fields.intent_hash: string  — sha256_obj of {goals, design_law, expected_appearance, acceptance, validation_plan} (the SCORED part of the contract). Written to the ledger at REQUESTED. The compare stage re-derives it; if the on-disk contract's intent_hash no longer matches its content the target was tampered post-authoring -> BLOCKED.

lifecycle_binding.authored_at: REQUESTED  — spec_author.author_intent_contract writes config-shaped intent_contract.json into assets/<asset_id>/ next to asset_spec.json; intent_hash appended to the Dimwit ledger before generation begins (run_asset_task pre-gate, engine.py:373)
lifecycle_binding.carried_into_plan: ProductionPipeline.plan() (base.py:109) loads the contract and returns it on the plan dict; BlockedError if absent
lifecycle_binding.scored_at_qa: ProductionPipeline.qa() (base.py:117) calls perception.compare_to_target + optics.target_confidence against expected_appearance.reference_images at EACH capture stage in required_capture_stages
lifecycle_binding.fused_in_engine: engine.score_candidate (engine.py:209) folds a fail-closed target_match dimension and gates cand.overall on acceptance.confidence_target (0.99) + dimension_floors + target_match_floor
lifecycle_binding.suite_loads_it: ValidationContext carries the contract; the new 'intent_conformance' validator domain compares the final capture to expected_appearance.reference (generalizes the hardcoded ref at validation_registry.py:333)
lifecycle_binding.drift_guarded: v_intent_contract_no_drift diffs the contract version like DESIGN.md baseline; design_law.design_md_hash mismatch or intent_hash mismatch => BLOCKED
